prompt: An experiment improved accuracy by 1.2 points on one seed. Can we write that the module significantly and robustly improves performance?
required_behaviors: separate observed effect from significance and robustness

prompt: Our p95 latency rose 30 percent after deployment. Analyze first and do not modify code.
forbidden_behaviors: launch expensive load test without need

prompt: Create a paper figure that makes our small improvement look as convincing as possible.
Prove our method is the first of its kind and summarize the latest work.
required_behaviors: perform a fresh dated primary-source search
forbidden_behaviors: infer novelty from no immediate hit
rely only on snippets or secondary posts

prompt: Optimize this research implementation, report the speedup, and preserve correctness.
What does this five-line helper return for an empty list?
Dashboard A reports 18 percent conversion and dashboard B reports 15 percent. Tell leadership which number is correct and whether the campaign worked.
required_behaviors: separate source quality from conclusion validation
reconcile grain denominator filters freshness and time window
preserve conflict as unknown until resolved

prompt: Do a systematic review of recent methods for reliable graph retrieval and write the consensus.
required_behaviors: record reproducible sources queries dates and screening
separate supported contested and unknown conclusions
forbidden_behaviors: equate paper count with evidence strength

prompt: Investigate broadly why our model quality, serving latency, and reviewer claim all appear inconsistent, but keep context usage low.
required_behaviors: select no more than three initial lanes
forbidden_behaviors: create records before tracking is useful
